metadata.title: U.S. Mud / Below project case anchors
metadata.purpose: Small, explicitly project-symbolic map anchors for selected U.S. cases already discussed in the Potatoverse Below/Farm corpus. These are not objective classifications of people and the coordinates are intentionally broad state centroids, not residences or current locations.

properties.label: Chris Chan / CWCki case
properties.project_relation: Persistent-target ecology and Farm/archive case in the project corpus.
properties.boundary: This marker represents a project case study anchored only to Virginia. It does not classify the person as a literal Mud Dweller and does not identify a home or current location.

properties.label: Cyraxx / reaction-loop case
properties.project_relation: Cyraxx appears in the Great Book's Mud Dweller storyline and in the project's Farm/reaction-loop research.
properties.boundary: This is Tim/project symbolic language preserved as attribution. The point is an Ohio state centroid, not a residence or current location.
